notes_for_editor: Thin record. One substantive source (NHLR). The Forest Lookouts Leeds page has only a header (Chester County, Sumter National Forest, satellite view). Two web searches for current status or staffing found nothing. The record's status 'standing' is not supported by any source read, so facts omit status; a human should check whether the tower still stands, perhaps through the Forest Service Enoree Ranger District. Height 100 ft converted to 30.5 m (structure height). Elevation in the record (200.3 m) matches NHLR. Story uses 'about 1936' for the build year. No photos added; the record already holds the NHLR image (us959_leeds.jpg).
